controlled_full_turn_gate.players: entire owned RobotPlayer/Launcher turn including initialization, shared sensing, map work, telemetry and end-turn planning; all remaining robots are owned scripted fixture actors
controlled_full_turn_gate.setup: one frozen custom 20x20 map, boxed launcher at (6,6), sole attack-range hidden cloud at (9,6); native movement legality, cooldowns and damage remain authoritative

fixed_phases.target: own scripted enemy carrier held on hidden cloud; refill only after death at the following round boundary
own scripted allied carrier on hidden cloud
own scripted visible enemy carrier at distance squared four; retain hidden cloud
hidden cloud plus a fixed passable friendly crowd; include positive bs counters on no-shot and off-phase turns

observations: native attack-entry position, target, canSenseLocation, cooldown, rounded actual team multiplier and victim health before/after
native next own-start cooldown and exact launcher attack events
per-robot cumulative blindShots reflected only while its actual sandbox is paused, and emitted bs token with explicit missing/truncated coverage
whole sandbox bytecodes, pre-fill maxBc, overrun/exception counters and ordinary attack traces
later map/field work coverage; equal final padded bytecodes alone do not prove equal useful work
controlled_full_turn_gate.zero_gate: frozen base and period zero must match every round's native state, actions and metered bytecodes after package-name normalization
controlled_full_turn_gate.positive_gate: period one must deliver at least one hidden enemy hit for 20 and one empty miss; ally damage is zero; each fired hook has next-start CD zero and exact counter/action join
controlled_full_turn_gate.limits: fixture actors and forced cutoff are explicit; no winner, opponent realism, field frequency or local superiority claim

map_hash_verification: expected bytes are from pinned engine source; verify this resource hash in the SHA-pinned official release jar before any game

complete_game_conditions.seed: fixed built-in map seed, same labels and sides within a cell
complete_game_conditions.baseline_control: the unchanged frozen c_mend2 replaces the experimental package in the identical cell; a prior game is reusable only if every engine, JDK, map, side, source and configuration pin matches
complete_game_conditions.zero_gate: baseline and period zero require identical full state/action and bytecode fingerprints, winner/footer and round count in all four cells before active-dose expansion
complete_game_conditions.dose_delivery: after each paired active dose, report hook firings, useful hidden hits and native hit damage, zero-damage misses, counter coverage/gaps, conservative generic visibility bounds, basics and work-cost limits
complete_game_conditions.counter_attribution: only adjacent reliable samples with delta bs one identify that round's sole launcher attack; gaps permit interval totals, not guessed hit attribution
complete_game_conditions.useful_damage_gate: period one needs at least one identified hidden hit (20 native damage) across the four fixed cells; zero useful damage with complete coverage closes the arm before adding cells or ladder work
complete_game_conditions.observability_gate: missing counter/action attribution prevents acceptance; repair measurement before score expansion, without treating missing data as zero
falsifiers: any zero-control state, action, bytecode or footer mismatch
any new overrun, caught/uncaught exception or displaced ordinary attack in the controlled fixture
any nonzero next-start cooldown after a fired controlled hook
any complete-observation counter/action mismatch or allied damage
no useful hidden hit damage across the fixed period-one cells with complete coverage
worse basics or useful planning work starved by hook/suffix price
complete_game_conditions.promotion: delivery is a necessary gate only; local superiority requires the normal frozen-roster procedure, and ladder play remains a separate policy-controlled trial
